RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

Do not raise allegations of sex discrimination directly with the department, as that risks professional reprisal in a tight academic field. However, check whether your university’s hiring policy mandates gender diversity on selection panels. If an institutional rule was violated, you have grounds for a procedural appeal through HR or a faculty union.

An all-male panel in economics often reflects senior demographic imbalances rather than conscious bias, though homophily and implicit bias can influence subjective assessments of "fit." Concurrently, lecturer appointments frequently weigh interview performance and industry experience above publications. 

First, send a polite follow-up regarding your written feedback request, and consult a union representative or ombudsperson before taking formal action.
